$comment: Chemistry course outline. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track (S1); the zero-to-hero core is added at M1. Order and grouping follow research/verified-2026-11-15.json (chemistry, verification.final_units). Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: chemistry
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied 必修化學 in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.

Unit order and grouping follow the verified research (final_units 2–18), which is adapted from, not identical to, 翰林 化學（全）: the mole comes after bonding (翰林 teaches it in 1-2); both orders are allowed by the 課綱.
CEc-Vc-1 (gas pressure from molecular collisions) is merged into the states/phase-diagram chapter, as the 課綱 說明 says (與其他章節合併說明); gas laws are 選修 CEc-Va.
CMb-Vc-1 is woven into the basic-laws chapter (課綱: 不必另成一個單元) and listed again in the chemistry-and-society chapter.
Sprint merges to keep about 25-minute review chapters: units 2+3 (states, separation), 8+9 (balancing, stoichiometry), 11+12 (solutions, solubility).
Tested enrichment beyond the 必修 說明 is flagged, not dropped: atom-plus-charge balancing of ionic equations (111 Q57-2) and 再結晶 (112/114 options). No 氧化數.

Cross-subject prereqs: the mole chapter and the acid–base chapter need math/s116-logarithms (scientific-notation arithmetic N-10-1 and common logarithms N-10-4; 國中 N-7-8 excludes scientific-notation arithmetic).

Owner approved the 自然 sprint outline (2026-11-16): keep the 60-chapter size; write ONE subject at a time (rate limits); biology relies on the shared inquiry exam-skills part; the shared 自然 mock is the only science practice paper; environment-energy stays one chapter.
openQuestions: Owner approval of this outline (S1 gate) is pending.
The environment chapter covers 9 codes (CMe-Vc-1~4, CNa-Vc-1~4, CNc-Vc-1), which the research treats as one unit; split it if a chapter-level reading of the 課綱 shows two clear clusters.
Integrator (2026-11-16): the whole-paper 自然 practice paper is the shared capstone inquiry/s116-sci-mock; this file has no capstone of its own.
Exam-item links (examItems) and reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2.
The 探究與實作 skills (final_units 1) are cross-subject inq codes; how chemistry chapters link to them is decided with the other science outlines.

question.zh-tw: 物質由什麼組成？粒子之間又怎麼結合在一起？
question.en: What is matter made of, and how do its particles hold together?

parts.whyHere: Verified final_units 2–6 in order: classification/states/phase diagrams (with CEc-Vc-1 merged in, verified correction) → separation (depends on classification) → basic laws and atomic theory (CMb-Vc-1 woven in) → atomic structure and periodic table → bonding. Everything later uses atoms, formulas and bonds.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修化學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required (必修) chemistry in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 物質的分類、三態與分離

blurb.zh-tw: 純物質與混合物、三相圖，以及蒸餾、萃取與色層分析。
blurb.en: Pure substances and mixtures, phase diagrams, and distillation, extraction and chromatography.

objectives.zh-tw: 由溫度與壓力判斷物質的狀態，讀懂水與二氧化碳的三相圖
objectives.en: Use temperature and pressure to decide a substance's state, and read the H2O and CO2 phase diagrams

objectives.zh-tw: 用分子撞擊器壁說明氣體壓力
objectives.en: Explain gas pressure as molecules hitting the container walls

objectives.zh-tw: 依混合物的性質選擇蒸餾、萃取或色層分析來分離
objectives.en: Choose distillation, extraction or chromatography to separate a mixture by its properties

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: phase diagrams only for H2O and CO2; gas laws are 選修 (leave out); ink distillation, pigment extraction, TLC, hard water and softening, seawater purification; flag 再結晶 as enrichment (112/114 options).

title.zh-tw: 化學基本定律與原子說
title.en: Basic laws of chemistry and atomic theory

blurb.zh-tw: 質量守恆、定比與倍比定律，到道耳頓的原子說。
blurb.en: Conservation of mass, definite and multiple proportions, and Dalton's atomic theory.

objectives.zh-tw: 用質量守恆、定比定律與倍比定律解釋實驗數據
objectives.en: Explain experimental data with conservation of mass and the laws of definite and multiple proportions

objectives.zh-tw: 說明道耳頓原子說如何解釋這些定律
objectives.en: Explain how Dalton's atomic theory accounts for these laws

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: Lavoisier (element concept, oxidation, mass check), definite proportions, multiple proportions with no complex calculation, Dalton; weave in scientists of varied genders and backgrounds (CMb-Vc-1).

title.zh-tw: 原子結構、同位素與週期表
title.en: Atomic structure, isotopes and the periodic table

blurb.zh-tw: 質子、中子、電子，同位素，以及前 18 號元素的週期性。
blurb.en: Protons, neutrons and electrons, isotopes, and periodic trends in the first 18 elements.

objectives.zh-tw: 由質子數、中子數與質量數辨認同位素
objectives.en: Identify isotopes from proton number, neutron number and mass number

objectives.zh-tw: 寫出原子序 1–18 元素的價電子數並說明週期性
objectives.en: Give the valence electrons of elements Z=1–18 and explain the periodic trends

objectives.zh-tw: 分辨金屬、類金屬與非金屬
objectives.en: Tell metals, metalloids and nonmetals apart

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: valence electrons and trends for Z=1–18 only; isotopes only with C and H examples, named element + mass number; orbitals and electron configuration are 選修 CAa-Va (leave out).

title.en: Chemical bonds and the properties of substances

blurb.zh-tw: 共價鍵、離子鍵、金屬鍵，以及結構如何決定性質。
blurb.en: Covalent, ionic and metallic bonds, and how structure decides properties.

objectives.zh-tw: 畫出 H2O、NH3、CH4、C2H4、CO2 的路易斯結構
objectives.en: Draw the Lewis structures of H2O, NH3, CH4, C2H4 and CO2

objectives.zh-tw: 比較離子化合物、分子化合物、共價網狀固體與金屬的性質
objectives.en: Compare the properties of ionic compounds, molecular compounds, covalent network solids and metals

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: Lewis structures only for H2O, NH3, CH4, C2H4, CO2; ionic bonding with NaCl and MgO, no lattice packing, shape or energy; carbon allotropes and Si network solids; electron-sea model.

question.zh-tw: 看不見的粒子，要怎麼「數」？
question.en: How do you count particles you cannot see?

parts.whyHere: Verified final_units 7–10: the mole after bonding (adapted from 翰林, verified correction) → balancing → stoichiometry → energy changes (depends on stoichiometry). Scientific-notation arithmetic must be reviewed before mole work (verified correction: 國中 N-7-8 excludes it; N-10-1), hence the math prereq.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修化學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required (必修) chemistry in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.en: Chemical formulas, atomic weight and the mole

blurb.zh-tw: 分子式與實驗式、百分組成，以及莫耳與莫耳質量。
blurb.en: Molecular and empirical formulas, percent composition, the mole and molar mass.

objectives.zh-tw: 由百分組成求實驗式
objectives.en: Find an empirical formula from percent composition

objectives.zh-tw: 以亞佛加厥數與莫耳質量換算粒子數、莫耳數與質量
objectives.en: Convert between particle count, moles and mass with Avogadro's number and molar mass

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: atomic and molecular weight as relative masses; the mole from scratch (國中 does no mole calculations); multiply and divide in scientific notation explicitly (N-10-1).

title.zh-tw: 化學反應式與化學計量

blurb.zh-tw: 平衡反應式的係數，再用係數算出莫耳與質量的關係。
blurb.en: Balancing equations, then using the coefficients to relate moles and masses.

objectives.zh-tw: 用觀察法與代數法平衡化學反應式
objectives.en: Balance chemical equations by inspection and by algebra

objectives.zh-tw: 由平衡的反應式計算反應物與生成物的莫耳數與質量
objectives.en: Calculate the moles and masses of reactants and products from a balanced equation

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: no complex equations; no 產率 and no gas-volume calculations (limiting reagent and yield are 選修); flag atom-plus-charge balancing of ionic equations as tested enrichment (111 Q57-2); show a written setup.

title.zh-tw: 化學反應中的能量變化

blurb.zh-tw: 放熱與吸熱反應、能量變化圖與熱化學反應式。
blurb.en: Exothermic and endothermic reactions, energy diagrams and thermochemical equations.

objectives.zh-tw: 由能量變化圖判斷放熱或吸熱
objectives.en: Tell exothermic from endothermic reactions on an energy diagram

objectives.zh-tw: 寫出熱化學反應式並依係數換算熱量
objectives.en: Write thermochemical equations and scale the heat with the coefficients

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: energy conservation in ordinary reactions; Hess's law and heats of formation are 選修 CBa-Va (leave out).

title.en: Solutions, acids and bases, and redox

question.zh-tw: 物質溶在水裡之後，會發生哪些反應？
question.en: What reactions happen once substances dissolve in water?

parts.whyHere: Verified final_units 11–14: solutions and molarity (needs the mole) → solubility (needs solutions) → acid–base (needs solutions; math N-10-1 and N-10-4 for pH, verified correction) → redox (needs atomic structure and balancing).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修化學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required (必修) chemistry in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

blurb.zh-tw: 真溶液、膠體與懸浮液，體積莫耳濃度，以及溶解度與溫度。
blurb.en: True solutions, colloids and suspensions, molarity, and solubility versus temperature.

objectives.zh-tw: 依粒子大小分辨真溶液、膠體與懸浮液
objectives.en: Sort true solutions, colloids and suspensions by particle size

objectives.zh-tw: 計算體積莫耳濃度，並說明配製與稀釋溶液的方法
objectives.en: Calculate molarity and explain how to prepare and dilute a solution

objectives.zh-tw: 讀溶解度曲線，說明飽和溶液的溶解平衡
objectives.en: Read a solubility curve and explain the dissolving equilibrium of a saturated solution

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: the only colloid property is the Tyndall effect; dilution reasoning taught explicitly (國中 excludes it); no 再結晶 and no hydrated solutes.

blurb.zh-tw: 水的自解離、阿瑞尼斯酸鹼學說、pH 與強弱電解質。
blurb.en: Self-ionization of water, Arrhenius acids and bases, pH, and strong versus weak electrolytes.

objectives.zh-tw: 用 [H+][OH−] = 1.00×10^-14（25℃）與 pH = −log[H+] 判斷溶液的酸鹼性
objectives.en: Use [H+][OH−] = 1.00×10^-14 at 25℃ and pH = −log[H+] to judge whether a solution is acidic or basic

objectives.zh-tw: 分辨強酸、弱酸、強鹼、弱鹼與強弱電解質
objectives.en: Tell strong from weak acids, bases and electrolytes

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: pH without complex calculation; acid–base indicators lab; Brønsted–Lowry, Ka/Kb and buffers are 選修 CJd-Va (leave out).

blurb.zh-tw: 從得失氧到得失電子，以及常見的氧化劑與還原劑。
blurb.en: From gaining and losing oxygen to gaining and losing electrons, and common oxidizing and reducing agents.

objectives.zh-tw: 用電子轉移判斷氧化與還原
objectives.en: Identify oxidation and reduction by electron transfer

objectives.zh-tw: 辨認日常生活中常見的氧化劑、還原劑與抗氧化劑
objectives.en: Recognize common oxidizing agents, reducing agents and antioxidants in daily life

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: oxidizers O2, O3, H2O2, HOCl, Cl2; reducers coke, SO2; antioxidant vitamin C; no 氧化數; atom-plus-charge balancing only as flagged tested enrichment (111 Q57).

title.en: Chemistry in life, technology and the environment

question.zh-tw: 化學怎麼改變我們的生活與地球？
question.en: How does chemistry change our lives and our planet?

parts.whyHere: Verified final_units 15–18: surface area and rate with advanced technology (課綱 pairs CJe-Vc-2 with CMc-Vc-3; needs bonding and redox) → everyday organic matter (needs bonding) → chemistry in daily life and history (needs separation, acid–base, redox) → pollution and energy (needs acid–base, redox, energy changes).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修化學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required (必修) chemistry in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 接觸面積、反應速率與先進科技
title.en: Surface area, reaction rate and advanced technology

blurb.zh-tw: 接觸面積如何影響反應速率，以及奈米材料與光觸媒。
blurb.en: How surface area changes reaction rate, plus nanomaterials and photocatalysts.

objectives.zh-tw: 定量說明接觸面積與反應速率的關係
objectives.en: Describe quantitatively how surface area affects reaction rate

objectives.zh-tw: 說明奈米尺度，以及奈米碳管與二氧化鈦光觸媒的應用
objectives.en: Explain the nanoscale and the uses of carbon nanotubes and TiO2 photocatalysts

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: surface area is the only rate factor in 必修; carbon nanotubes and TiO2 without structures; 114 and 115 used nano-material 題組.

blurb.zh-tw: 醣類、蛋白質、脂質與核酸的組成，以及肥皂與清潔劑如何去汙。
blurb.en: What carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids are made of, and how soaps and detergents remove dirt.

objectives.zh-tw: 說出醣類、蛋白質、脂質與核酸的組成
objectives.en: State what carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids are made of

objectives.zh-tw: 用親油端與親水端說明界面活性劑的去汙原理
objectives.en: Explain how surfactants remove dirt with their oil-loving and water-loving ends

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: biomolecules with no complex structures; soap and detergent structure; surfactant lab.

title.en: Chemistry in daily life and the history of science

blurb.zh-tw: 水的處理、常見藥物，以及化學家的貢獻與化學的未來。
blurb.en: Water treatment, common medicines, and the contributions of chemists and the future of chemistry.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明水的淨化、消毒與軟化
objectives.en: Explain how water is purified, disinfected and softened

objectives.zh-tw: 說明制酸劑等常見藥物的作用
objectives.en: Explain what common medicines such as antacids do

objectives.zh-tw: 舉例說明不同性別與背景科學家對化學的貢獻
objectives.en: Give examples of contributions to chemistry by scientists of varied genders and backgrounds

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: effects of chemical processes on life, society, economy and environment (課綱: 0.2 periods, may be taught with Mc); water treatment; antacids, anti-inflammatories, painkillers.

title.zh-tw: 環境汙染、永續發展與能源

blurb.zh-tw: 酸雨、全球暖化、臭氧層破洞與工業廢水，以及永續發展與新興能源。
blurb.en: Acid rain, global warming, the ozone hole and industrial wastewater, plus sustainability and emerging energy.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明酸雨、全球暖化、臭氧層破洞與工業廢水的成因、影響與對策
objectives.en: Explain the causes, effects and remedies of acid rain, global warming, the ozone hole and industrial wastewater

objectives.zh-tw: 用水循環與碳循環說明永續發展與水資源回收
objectives.en: Use the water and carbon cycles to explain sustainable development and water recycling

chapters.activity: 116 sprint review: PM2.5 and photochemical smog may be mentioned; emerging energy in Taiwan (wind, solar); nuclear energy belongs to physics (leave out).

question.zh-tw: 化學題組與非選題，怎麼拿到分數？
question.en: How do you earn the points on chemistry 題組 and written items?

parts.whyHere: Exam-format concepts are owned by the site exam-literacy part; this chapter only applies them to chemistry. Verified: scoring of written items is set per item, not a general partial-credit-for-setup rule (111 評分原則: Q38 all-or-nothing, Q57 partial for 氧化反應 alone or fractional/doubled coefficients); more than half of 115 chemistry items used charts.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過必修化學、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied required (必修) chemistry in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 化學題組與非選題的作答
title.en: Answering chemistry 題組 and written items

blurb.zh-tw: 從圖表與題幹找線索，並寫出評分原則看得懂的算式與反應式。
blurb.en: Finding clues in charts and stems, and writing setups and equations the marking guide can follow.

objectives.zh-tw: 從探究題組的圖表與題幹找出作答需要的資訊
objectives.en: Pull the information you need from the charts and stem of an inquiry 題組

objectives.zh-tw: 清楚寫出計算過程，並以最簡整數係數寫出反應式
objectives.en: Show the working clearly and write equations with the smallest whole-number coefficients

chapters.activity: 116 sprint exam-skills chapter: original worked items modelled on official 題組; scoring is per item (111 Q38 all-or-nothing, Q57 partial credit), never promised as a general rule; options beyond 必修 are answered from stem clues.
